_note: Water (systems/water.js: the towns' wells, fouled wells, sieges, armies and ships; player/thirst.js: the player's thirst; ui/actionMenu/water.js the Water panel; ui/innerMapWater.js the street map's wells, pumps and rivers). player.thirst: 100 slaked .. 0 parched. drain: thirst lost a world day; heat: × (1 + (temp - hotAbove) × perHeat) above hotAbove (the tile's temperature with its season and the climate's era, world/climate.js seasonalTemp), × terrain on desert and the like, × coldMult below coldBelow; march: × for a day with marchHexes or more hexes walked; fight: × for a day with a fight. draught: thirst one draught gives (a skin holds skin.draughts, a cask — a barrel in the pack — cask.draughts; filled free at a well, a river or a lake). autoBelow: the character drinks from the skins without being told below this. drinks: what ale, cider, mead, wine or milk in the pack gives a draught (drunk only below drinksBelow, and never on a vow: it's for survival). parched: below `below` the day is shorter (movement × moveMult), below `badBelow` shorter still; at 0 each day parched costs healthPerDay[days-1] health (the last repeats) — death in three or four days. foulWater: drinking a fouled well's water anyway: fluxChance of the flux (systems/ailments.js). rain: a day of rain gives `thirst` and fills `draughts` of the skins. buyWater: in a town whose wells are all foul, water carted in from elsewhere, `price` a draught (to the town's purse: its water carriers). startSkins: the waterskins a character first takes up (filled). town: wells by size, + perEra a town era (world/townEras.js); a river or a lake beside a town is a source of its own (the sea is salt). foul: days a well stays foul by cause; clean: the well-diggers' price per foul well (cleanDays to clear it). noWater: a town with no clean source — mood a day, the share of its people who sicken drinking it anyway (dailySick; partSick while some wells still run clean), the coin a day per 100 souls it pays water carriers (to the nearest town with water), and fleeShare a week of its people who go to the nearest town. drought: in summer, in a drought (the climate's era with wet below wetBelow at the town, or a drought event of the world), a town with no river or lake may find its wells run dry: weekChance a week, for days. plague: a town with a serious plague: weekChance a week the dead foul a well. agent: a town of a realm at war: weekChance a week an enemy agent fouls a well. siege: a besieged town with no clean water drinks its cisterns (cisternDays by size, + stoneEraDays from the stone era up), then thirsts (morale and garrison lost a day). holdingFoul: the besiegers of your holding foul its wells on foulDay of the siege (chance). camp: a siege camp far from a river or lake loses campMorale a day hauling water. army: your army's units drink from the land; a dry day past graceDays costs unitShare of the land units (at least one). host: a commanded host away at war with no water near loses morale and desertShare men a day. ship: a ship carries capDays of water for its crew, filled free at a port with clean water; with none left at sea, morale and crewShare of the crew a day past graceDays.

player._land: Water off the land where you stop for the night with no river, lake or town on the hex: a river or lake a hex off is a short walk (always found); else the land's streams, springs, snowmelt and pools — a hash roll at terrain[id] (default for any other), × season, × droughtMult in a drought age of the climate, + perSkill a point of hunting, foraging or survival (at most skillMax). Generated maps put a river, lake or town on about one hex in fifteen, two to four hexes apart: the hexes between are a day's walk across and have their own small water, the desert hardly any.

desert: a dry wash with water under the sand

_aiArmy: The realms' armies: a war host or relief host on the map (systems/realmWars.js, systems/sieges.js) with no river or lake on or beside its hex, and no clean town, loses strengthShare of its strength a day past graceDays. The realms' own battles (world/kingdomAI.js simulateBattle via world/waterSources.js): an attack on a frontline in dry country × dryAttack and the attacker loses dryAttrition of its army; a town with every well foul or dry and no river or lake defends × dryDefense. The besiegers of your holding far from water lose siege.camp.campMorale a day.

lines.parched: Your tongue is thick and your head pounds. Find water: a well, a river, a lake — or a skin of it.
lines.foulDrink: The water stinks, and you drink it anyway.
